home.addr.body.zh: 总线上有两个地址，只差最低一位：A0h 是 1010000X，A2h 是 1010001X，其中 X 是读写位。A0h 放身份与静态参数，A2h 放诊断、阈值与校准常量；两块各 256 字节，互不覆盖。
home.addr.body.en: Two addresses sit one bit apart: A0h is 1010000X and A2h is 1010001X, where X is the read/write bit. A0h holds identity and static parameters; A2h holds diagnostics, thresholds and calibration constants. Each block is 256 bytes and neither overwrites the other.

home.block.a0.zh: 身份与静态参数，256 字节

home.block.a2.zh: 诊断、阈值与校准，256 字节

home.bus.body.zh: 主机与模块之间只有两根信号线：一根时钟，一根数据。所有读写都走这条两线串行总线，没有额外的控制线。
home.bus.body.en: Host and module share just two wires: one clock, one data. Every read and write — including address selection — travels on this two-wire serial bus, with no extra control lines.

home.cal.body.zh: 诊断量怎么读，取决于模块声明的校准方式。内部校准：模块用自身的内部常量换算好，A2h 96-105 直接给出物理量。外部校准：模块只给出 A/D 原始计数，读数要拿 A2h 56-95 的常量自己算。
home.cal.body.en: How you read a measurement depends on the calibration the module declares. With internal calibration the module converts using its own constants, so A2h 96-105 already holds physical values. With external calibration the module reports raw A/D counts, and you apply the constants at A2h 56-95 yourself.

home.lede.zh: 这颗模块用一条两线串行总线，把 512 个字节摊开给主机看：一块说「我是谁」，一块说「我现在怎么样」。
home.lede.en: The module exposes 512 bytes over a single two-wire serial bus: one block says who it is, the other says how it is doing.

index.lede.zh: 已收录 {collected} / {size} 个字节。标为「待补」的字节表示本站尚未收录，不代表该字节不存在。
index.lede.en: Collected {collected} / {size} bytes. A byte marked “pending” has not been collected here yet; its absence does not mean the byte does not exist.
